title: A developer who likes understanding the whole picture.
intro: I enjoy working across the stack: shaping a clear interface, designing the API behind it, and making sure the pieces are reliable in production. My experience has taken me from Japan to Spain and across Java, Python, JavaScript, Vue, and cloud deployments.
approach: I learn by building. Whether it is a family meal planner with AI, a device management system, or a small command-line tool, I like turning a real problem into something focused, useful, and easy to improve.
